children: Securitize shares rose after the company signed a memorandum of understanding to continue advancing digital-asset infrastructure in the Emirate of Dubai.
The stock advanced 9% to $7.09 on Thursday. Shares are still down 37% this year.
Dubai's Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority signed the memorandum with Securitize, establishing a framework for collaboration to advance tokenization in Dubai.
Projects under the memorandum will include ecosystem development, talent attraction, market education, data-driven research and the evolution of tokenized financial products.
